column2: Capturing Guadalcanal will let us control naval operations in the South Pacific and routes to and from Australia.
Holding Wake Island will extend reconnaissance and air cover over central Pacific routes.
Control of Midway will secure the central Pacific and provide a key base for transoceanic operations.
Capturing Pearl Harbor will consolidate our Pacific presence, simplify logistics coordination throughout the theatre and provide access to America's Pacific coast.
Capturing Attu will establish control of North Pacific shipping routes and enable operations along the Aleutian chain towards Alaska and America's Pacific coast.
It is time to end this shameful diktat. We will reclaim our rightful territories!
A large-scale strategic bombing campaign will systematically undermine enemy industrial capacity and exhaust their strength.
The enemy occupies our lands. Liberating them must be our first priority.
A major offensive seizing enemy territory will be our first step towards final victory.
